known_gap.reason: C7-M4 S2 executed a native FCStd/XML restore probe that patched Chamfer.Base LinkSub to Sub value=OldFilletEdge1 plus shadow=Edge1 and reopened the document through FreeCADCmd. Reopen and recompute succeeded and Python-visible Chamfer.Base became Edge1, but FreeCAD Python only exposes the LinkSub value tuple and dumpPropertyContent; it does not expose Base.getShadowSubs(), getSubValues(false), or getSubValues(true). Therefore S2 still cannot prove the native ShadowSub lifecycle required by the implementation gate. The StableSubList-fed collector output remains a negative control only.

dumpPropertyContent_sub_attrs.shadow: FreeCAD-generated stable shadow token for Edge1

stablesublist_fed_negative_control.collector_gap: collect_freecad_expected.py::link_sub_value() feeds StableSubList to FreeCAD PropertyLinkSub, so this output proves only Edge1-fed geometry and cannot replace the native restore probe.
